title: BOOT-03 reproducible CI and build artifact qualification

changes.description: Implement an isolated local CI pipeline and matching reviewed SHA-pinned Actions definition, frozen graph/license/advisory/secret gates and hashed sanitized build artifacts.

Correct all independently reproduced CI lifecycle/cancellation/stopped-resource/history/manifest/audit/CLI/log-redaction findings; reject shallow sources and nested unreviewed job permissions with failed red and green regressions.
Maintain CI operation/ADR/qualification/status/handoff, explicit scan/host/device limits and complete source impact map; preserve original requirements and append-only executed evidence.

Add guarded source/history scanning, frozen installed-graph reports, source/image/lock artifact identity and UUID resource lifecycle; extend evidence redaction to safely owned credentials before and after execution with fail-closed output withholding.

Final RUN028 passed twelve actual isolated pipeline stages,79 foundation regressions, eight restricted identities, five live PostgreSQL checks and four Linux software-WebGL browser checks; RUN029 verified90 artifact payload entries plus manifest,200 installed npm components, ten notice gaps and zero registry advisories.

Independent read-only review reproduced nine findings; all were corrected with retained red/green tests and fresh whole-source proof. No important finding is waived; review is reported with unknown historical execution times.

RUN030 requalified disposable database recreation; RUN031 passed canonical Git frozen installation and79 tests. RUN032 retained an incorrect probe-volume expectation; corrected RUN033 proved actual cleanup, protected private/workspace state, original scope/provenance and staged formatting. Clock-discontinuous RUN026 remains failed without weakening timing safeguards.
